meta.title: US vehicle reference (2000-present) for Car Doctor
notes: Ranked by approximate cumulative US sales of the model line since 2000; popularity_score is relative (100 = Ford F-Series), not a unit count.
Each entry is one generation; engines lists the US powertrain variations.
common_problems are widely reported patterns, not guarantees. Cross-check with NHTSA recalls/complaints (api.nhtsa.gov) before presenting as a diagnosis.
Some generations start before 2000 because they were still sold new in 2000+.
